Maya (CSM): Quick weekly check-in for Thurso — sharing token + throughput snapshot. Seeing a WoW token increase of +38% but QoQ still only +6%. Latency median is 140ms (up from 110ms last week). Error rate spiked to 0.9% yesterday. Anyone on support rotation have context?
cs-bot: [automated snapshot] tokens_24h=1.2M, tokens_wow_change=+38%, tokens_qoq_change=+6%, median_latency_ms=140, p95_latency_ms=420, error_rate=0.9%, est_spend_30d=$14.2k
Jorge (Acct Owner): We enabled a stricter input validation earlier this week which might be causing retries from the client side — I saw a bump in 4xxs in the app logs. Will confirm with devs.
Tom (Eng): Can you paste the failing request examples? If they're small requests being retried it could explain token delta without QoQ growth. Also p95 jump looks like one long tail worker stuck — reopening a task.
Priya (Solutions): FYI we ran the new batching config in staging last night. If Thurso rolled that out on their side, batch size could change token/throughput characteristics. Any rollout notes?
Jorge (Acct Owner): @Priya no explicit rollout from our side. Validation change was server-side in our API gateway. I'll pull request logs.
Maya (CSM): Actions: 1) Jorge to confirm gateway errors + examples (Jorge) 2) Tom to triage server tail affecting p95 (Tom) 3) Priya to prepare a short enablement doc on batching impact for Thurso (Priya). Would be great to sync by EOD Friday.
Tom (Eng): Started a quick trace: found a worker OOM causing retry cascade around 04:12 UTC yesterday — increasing worker mem on that pool and adding circuit breaker for repeated 5xx. Will post PR.
cs-bot: Deployment event: infra/worker-pool mem bump deployed by Tom at 2876543240
Jorge (Acct Owner): Pulled request samples: most are 400s due to missing auth header; client lib bug being rolled out by mobile team. We'll patch and expect error rate to fall ~0.6% within 48hrs.
Maya (CSM): Great — if error rate drops and tokens normalize, we can reclassify this as transient onboarding noise. If not, renewal flag remains yellow.
Priya (Solutions): Drafting the batching playbook now. Sharing link: https://redwood.internal/enablement/thurso-batching-guide (will update with baseline vs. tuned numbers).
Maya (CSM): Estimated spend note: if tokens hold at current run-rate, monthly cost +12% vs last month. Recommend we offer a short runbook for client-side retry backoff and batching best practices to curb spend.
Jorge (Acct Owner): I'll coordinate mobile patch and update this thread when rollout hits canary. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
